delivery.outcome: Governance adopters can select an authorized self-hosted runner while repositories without configuration retain the hosted default.
nonGoals: Do not provision runners or change adopter repository settings in this standard ticket
Do not weaken required checks, exact-head checkout or approval policy

architecture.decision: Expose one runner-label input on the reusable workflow and one repository-variable override on the managed workflow, both defaulting to ubuntu-latest.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket; every workflow returns to ubuntu-latest.

validation.evidence: Managed and reusable workflows expose bounded runner selection with hosted fallback.

commands: for test_script in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$test_script"; done
